notes:
this was very silly: medium-base downloaded correctly, but Hugging Face represented its files as shortcuts into the model cache. we moved the shortcut and broke where it pointed.
this version follows the shortcut to the real model file before staging it, verifies every staged file, and gives pre-encoding the exact paths.
click update and retry the same one-audio-file, 5-step test. you should not need to download medium-base or rebuild the environment again.
